ICT 4 jaar Bachelor Voltijd Start februari en september Nederlands Eindhoven Tilburg

notes: Tuition: no fee for a non-EU/EEA student of THIS programme is stated. The Collegegeld page only says institution-set fees may apply to students from outside the EEA (quote: 'Dat is bijvoorbeeld het geval bij een tweede bachelor- of masteropleiding of als je uit een land komt dat geen onderdeel is van de Europese Economische Ruimte (EER).') without naming the ICT programme or any amount; the actual amount is only given via the collegegeldmeter. Therefore tuition left out. Intakes: the programme starts in February and September, but no day/month/year is given on the pages; only month names, so all dates null. Duration 4 years is stated for the regular Bachelor ICT; note the accelerated 'Versnelde Bachelor ICT & Software Engineering' track is 3 or 3.5 years, but the programme here is the 4-year Bachelor ICT. Teaching language: the programme page states 'Nederlands'; no page states this programme is taught in English. The applicationChannel evidence is from the general Fontys application page, which applies to this Bachelor programme.

note.fr: Vérifiez les conditions d'admission complètes pour les étudiants internationaux titulaires d'un diplôme étranger (page 'Aanmelden internationaal' / 'Toelating') : votre Baccalauréat marocain doit être évalué.
note.en: Check the full admission requirements for international students with a foreign diploma (page 'Aanmelden internationaal' / 'Toelating'): your Moroccan Baccalaureate must be assessed.
